name: blueprint
description: Juego web para aprender a diseñar arquitecturas en AWS completando diagramas.

scripts.content:validate: pnpm --reporter=silent content:prepare && pnpm --reporter=silent --dir tools/content exec tsx src/bin.ts validate
scripts.content:gen: pnpm --reporter=silent content:prepare && pnpm --reporter=silent --dir tools/content exec tsx src/bin.ts gen
scripts.content:build: pnpm --reporter=silent content:prepare && pnpm --reporter=silent --dir tools/content exec tsx src/bin.ts build
scripts.e2e: pnpm content:dev && pnpm content:e2e && turbo run build --filter=@blueprint/web && pnpm --filter @blueprint/web e2e
scripts.icons:fetch: pnpm --reporter=silent icons:prepare && pnpm --reporter=silent --dir tools/icons-fetch exec tsx src/bin.ts
scripts.build:site: pnpm icons:fetch && pnpm content:build --out dist/content && turbo run build --filter=@blueprint/web... --force && pnpm --reporter=silent site:prepare && pnpm --reporter=silent --dir tools/deploy-site exec tsx src/bin.ts assemble
scripts.preview:site: pnpm --reporter=silent site:prepare && pnpm --reporter=silent --dir tools/deploy-site exec tsx src/bin.ts preview
scripts.deploy:site: pnpm --reporter=silent site:prepare && pnpm --reporter=silent --dir tools/deploy-site exec tsx src/bin.ts deploy
